author: Liza Goodheart
title: Apple (AAPL) PT Set at $210.00 by Wells Fargo & Co - Enterprise Leader
text:
Posted by Liza Goodheart on Oct 13th, 2018 // No Comments
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been given a $210.00 price objective by investment analysts at Wells Fargo & Co in a research report issued on Monday, September 17th. The firm presently has a “neutral” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Wells Fargo & Co’s price objective suggests a potential downside of 5.45% from the company’s current price.
AAPL has been the subject of several other reports. Loop Capital boosted their target price on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, September 12th. Royal Bank of Canada reissued a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 11th. Independent Research set a $270.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, September 14th. Finally, Needham & Company LLC boosted their target price on Apple from $210.00 to $220.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, August 1st. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $221.63. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL stock traded up $7.66 on Monday, hitting $222.11. The stock had a trading volume of 39,486,990 shares, compared to its average volume of 31,432,369. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. The company has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a PE ratio of 24.12, a P/E/G ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. Apple has a 1 year low of $150.24 and a 1 year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business earned $1.67 EPS. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. Research analysts predict that Apple will post 11.76 EPS for the current fiscal year.
In other news, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, August 2nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total transaction of $4,131,600.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the director now directly owns 1,153,283 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $238,245,202.14. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last ninety days, insiders have sold 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213. 0.06% of the stock is owned by company insiders.
Several hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Fort L.P. acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter worth approximately $119,000. Delphi Private Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at $120,000. Cranbrook Wealth Management LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 76.1% during the 2nd quarter. Cranbrook Wealth Management LLC now owns 699 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $129,000 after buying an additional 302 shares during the last quarter. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $133,000. Finally, Smart Portfolios LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $134,000. 58.58% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
